description: One update bot for everything (replaces Dependabot). Lives in .github/ so it is part of the published mirror; update PRs are opened on GitHub and reach GitLab through backport:github.

packageRules.description: Actions: one weekly PR for minor/patch/digest bumps; majors separately.
The GitLab CI image bakes Playwright browsers for the same version the web tests use.
cargo-llvm-cov is pinned twice (GitLab image ARG, GitHub CI tool pin) and must move in lockstep.
SHA-256-pinned downloads in the GitLab CI image: Renovate cannot compute the new digest.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ This tool is SHA-256 pinned in `.gitlab/docker/Dockerfile.ci`: update the matching `*_SHA256` ARG in this PR. The `docker-pins` check stays red until it matches the release asset.

customManagers.description: cargo-llvm-cov version pinned for taiki-e/install-action in GitHub workflows.
